rules.title: San Diego Residential Tenant Protection Ordinance
rules.requirement: Landlords must have at-fault or no-fault just cause to terminate a covered tenancy, state the cause in the termination notice, and give the required notices. For no-fault terminations they must pay relocation assistance and offer the tenant a right of return. The ordinance also regulates buyout agreements and requires a notice of tenant protections.
rules.key_value: Relocation assistance of 2 months' rent (3 months for seniors 62+ or disabled tenants) for no-fault terminations
rules.penalty: Failure to comply with the right-of-offer rule renders the termination notice void (except for withdrawal from the rental market). Noncompliant buyout agreements are void.
rules.citation: San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 9, Article 8, Division 7
rules.status_basis: The ordinance goes into effect June 24, 2023.

exempt_if.text: Housing that has been issued a certificate of occupancy within the previous 15 years, unless the dwelling is a mobilehome.
Single-family owner-occupied residences where the owner-occupant rents no more than two units or bedrooms
Property with two separate dwelling units in a single structure

exempt_if.name: owner_occupied
exempt_if.text: Owner occupies one unit as principal residence; neither unit is an ADU or JADU
Residential unit alienable separate from the title to any other dwelling unit (e.g., a condominium)

exempt_if.name: landlord_not_REIT_corporation_or_LLC_with_corporate_member
exempt_if.text: Landlord is not a REIT, corporation, or LLC with a corporate member, and the tenants were given written notice of the exemption

exempt_if.name: deed_restricted_or_subsidized_affordable_housing
exempt_if.text: Housing restricted as affordable housing by deed or regulatory agreement, or subject to an affordable-housing subsidy agreement (not applicable to Section 8 voucher tenants)

exempt_if.name: transient_or_special_housing
exempt_if.text: Transient or tourist hotels, occupancies of 30 days or less, nonprofit hospitals, religious facilities, care facilities, nonprofit transitional housing, and school-owned dormitories

coverage.summary: Applies to tenancies of more than 30 days in residential rental property in San Diego.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Exempts housing with a certificate of occupancy issued within the previous 15 years, some owner-occupied small properties, separately alienable units owned by natural persons, affordable housing, hotels, dormitories and care facilities.

rules.quoted_span: The purpose of the Ordinance is to require Just Cause for termination of residential tenancies consistent with California Civil Code section 1946.2, to limit the reasons for termination of a residential tenancy, to require greater tenant relocation assistance in specified circumstances and to provide additional tenant protections.
